# llx

> llx is an ultrafast, lightweight agent runtime, one binary under 4 MB. It opens real browser pages (the system's WebView) and
> real terminal sessions as tabs of one native window, grouped by project, where a small decision
> model carries out a tab's goal and the person can comment on a page. It runs three ways from one
> binary: `llx`, a minimal agent at the terminal with seven tools; `llx exec`, one task for scripts
> and CI (JSON events, `--schema` answers, exit codes as a contract); and `llx mcp`, the same window
> for Claude Code, Codex or Cursor. It works with any model of the models.dev catalog and runs on
> macOS and Linux.

## Install

- `curl -fsSL https://llx.sh | sh` installs `llx` into `~/.local/bin`.
- Sign in with `/login` in a session (`llx`), or set the provider's key (for example `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`).

## Use

- `llx` opens a session at the terminal; `llx "<task>"` opens one that starts with that task.
- `llx exec "<task>"` (or `llx -p "<task>"`) runs one task and exits: the answer alone on stdout.
- `llx exec --json` prints one JSON event per line; `--schema` ends with data matching a JSON Schema.
- Exit codes: 0 achieved, 1 not achieved, 2 out of turns or time, 3 environment or usage, 130 interrupted.

## From another agent

- `llx mcp` serves llx's `window` (browser pages and terminal sessions as tabs, with a `goal` carried out by llx's decision model) to any agent that speaks MCP over stdio.
- Any MCP client: a server whose command is `llx` with the argument `mcp` (or `npx -y @localixai/llx mcp`).

## Links

- Source and docs: https://github.com/rsaryev/llx
